homeTitle: The Foundation for your Desktop App
homeSubtitle: A complete starter for Electron Forge + Vite + React 19 + shadcn/ui. Type-safe IPC, file-based routing, i18n, dark mode — batteries included.
homePreviewSubtitle: A few of the components installed in this template, rendered live below.
homePreviewAlertBody: Run `npm run bump-ui` to refresh shadcn components to their latest versions.
homeFeaturesSubtitle: Everything you need to ship a desktop app — wired up and ready to extend.
homeFeatureForgeDesc: Production-ready packaging, makers for Squirrel, ZIP, RPM, DEB. Auto-update via GitHub Releases.
homeFeatureViteDesc: Lightning-fast dev with Rolldown + React Compiler. Main, preload, and renderer all in one repo.
homeFeatureRouterDesc: Type-safe file-based routing with auto-generated route tree. Memory history for desktop apps.
homeFeatureShadcnDesc: 24+ components ready. Geist font. oklch colors. Dark mode by default.
homeFeatureOrpcDesc: Type-safe renderer↔main communication over MessagePort. No more IPC boilerplate.
homeFeatureShippedDesc: Vitest, Playwright E2E, Ultracite lint, GitHub Actions, Biome config — batteries included.
homeCtaSubtitle: 24+ shadcn/ui components ready to copy-paste into your app.
showcaseDescription: Live examples of every shadcn/ui component installed in this template. Use as a copy-paste reference when building new UI.
